BiblicalUsage: Jehoiakim is a Jewish king, the son of Josiah, who burned the scroll of Jeremiah. In 2 Kings 23:34, turned his name to Jehoiakim. The fuller story is told on the Jehoiakim, King of Judah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Jehoiakim belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile
